title: Missed-Visit Settlement Charge — Open No-Show Charge, Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
**Calculation clause.** For a missed Mobile In-Home Collection Visit of Specimen Collection Appointments, the missed-visit settlement charge is the no-show charge standing open on the missed visit, that is the assessed no-show fee less any waiver or payment posted against it plus any refund of such a payment, rounded to the cent.

**Percentages and rounding.** Percentage reliefs on a missed-visit settlement are first added together into one relief, and the open no-show charge is reduced once by that relief, taken as a percentage of the open no-show charge; the reliefs never act one after another. The result is rounded to the cent only once, at the end.

## The open no-show charge on the fee record

| Line on the missed visit's fee record | Effect on the open no-show charge |
|---|---|
| Assessed no-show fee | Adds its amount |
| Waiver of that fee | Takes its amount off |
| Payment of that fee | Takes its amount off |
| Refund of such a payment | Adds its amount back |

## Worked figures (hypothetical fee records)

| Assessed no-show fee | Waived | Paid | Refunded | Missed-visit settlement charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60.00 | — | — | — | 60.00 |
| 75.00 | — | — | — | 75.00 |
| 80.00 | 80.00 | — | — | 0.00 |

Illustration of the percentage rule with invented percentages: reliefs of 3 percent and 7 percent on an open no-show charge of 60.00 are added into one relief of 10 percent; 10 percent of 60.00 is 6.00; the result is 54.00.
